function: Channel estimation (denoising, extrapolation from reference-user pilots) and tracking of cascaded BS-STAR-RIS-user channels with quantum recurrent circuits (p. 3).
system: BS with 2 antennas, single-antenna users, energy-splitting STAR-RIS with 8 elements and 8 discrete phases, carrier wavelength 0.06 (no unit or frequency given) (p. 12).
method: Modular quantum recurrent neural network of variational quantum circuits (RY/CZ gates), supervised, gradient-free parameter updates, run on IBM Qiskit qasm_simulator (pp. 6, 10, 12).
data_channel: Custom simulated cascaded BS-STAR-RIS-user channel: Rician LoS plus correlated NLoS, path-loss exponent 2.2, Doppler time correlation; training data from earlier least-squares estimates (pp. 6-7, 10, 12).
test_conditions: One fixed setup for training and evaluation (NTx=2, N=8, one target user per region, walking speed); NMSE reported is the training loss (pp. 12-13).
baselines: Classical learned model with identical parameter count and depth: CNN1D denoising/extrapolation blocks plus Bi-LSTM tracker (pp. 13-14); no non-learned baseline compared.
metrics: NMSE of channel estimation (Fig. 4) and channel tracking (Fig. 5), also used as training loss, versus training episode and tracking time (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 7: "denotes the Rician factor of such channel"; custom Rician simulator with its own path loss (p. 12), no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "of different training scenarios, three cases are compared"; each case varies pilots or shots on the same setup, and no test on another scenario, band, antenna or user count.
q3_support: p. 13: "identical number of parameters and equivalent model depth"; the only baseline is a learned CNN1D/Bi-LSTM, compared on training-loss NMSE; no non-learned baseline (LS, MMSE) is plotted in Figs. 4-5.
q4_support: p. 3: "significantly reduces the computational requirements and overhead compared"; qualitative only, with no parameter count, FLOPs, order or runtime of the proposed method.
q5_support: p. 4: "the knowledge base (KB), which is composed of prior pilot"; training data come from the paper's own simulated pilots, with no code or data link.
notes: Learning is by trained variational quantum circuits run on a classical simulator (p. 12). Figs. 4 and 5 plot the training loss, so no held-out test is reported (pp. 12-13). Area 2 because the function is channel estimation and tracking.
